title: NVARCHAR Data Type
description: Learn how to use the NVARCHAR data type to store variable-length, Unicode string data.

data.text: The NVARCHAR data type stores variable-length, Unicode string data. Use NVARCHAR when you need to store Unicode characters such as Japanese Kanji or Korean Hangul.

data.title: NVARCHAR Syntax
data.content: Defines an NVARCHAR column with a specified length.

data.title: NVARCHAR(max) Syntax
data.content: Defines an NVARCHAR column with maximum storage of 2 GB.

data.text: n defines the string length from 1 to 4,000. The storage size is two times the number of characters entered plus 2 bytes.

rows: When data length varies and no Unicode needed

data.title: Create and Query NVARCHAR Column
data.content: Creates an NVARCHAR column and inserts a Japanese string.

data.title: NVARCHAR Key Points
points: NVARCHAR stores variable-length, Unicode string data.
Maximum length is 4,000 characters; use NVARCHAR(max) for up to 2 GB.
Storage size is 2 bytes per character plus 2 bytes overhead.
Use NVARCHAR when you need Unicode support (Japanese, Korean, Chinese).
ISO synonyms: NATIONAL CHAR VARYING or NATIONAL CHARACTER VARYING.
